in_marathi.name: Devadatta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devadatta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deva (god) + datta (gift). Devadatta is a name of great esteem in Hindu mythology, often given to boys born into noble families. It signifies the child as a divine blessing.

in_bengali.name: Devadatta
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's gift
in_bengali.long_meaning: Devadatta একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Deva (god) + datta (gift). Devadatta is a name of great esteem in Hindu mythology, often given to boys born into noble families. It signifies the child as a divine blessing.
